user.title: WeatherScope
user.description: Choose the centre and width of the map. Home Assistant downloads all map data itself, so your dashboards never need internet access.

data_description.location: Click on the map to move the centre. Your home location is shown on the map either way.
data_description.width_km: Visible width of the map, e.g. 750 km for Germany. A margin around it is loaded automatically so the card is always filled.
data_description.radar: Automatic chooses a radar that covers your map. At the moment only Germany (DWD) is available.

data_description.width_km: Visible width of the map, e.g. 750 km for Germany. A margin around it is loaded automatically so the card is always filled.
